links.comparator_used: Baseline GPT-4 Turbo without guideline context (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of answers on HCV guideline questions
links.effect: Accuracy improved from 43 to 99% (p < 0.001) when guidelines were provided as context in a coherent text corpus with non-text sources converted to text
links.quote: The results showed a significant improvement in accuracy from 43 to 99% (p < 0.001), when guidelines were provided as context in a coherent corpus of text and non-text sources were converted into text.

links.comparator_used: Guidelines in their original, unreformatted form (ablation of formatting strategies)
links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of answers on HCV guideline questions
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 43 to 99% (p < 0.001) with guidelines as a coherent text corpus and non-text sources converted to text. This is a combined effect with in-context guidelines, not isolated for format alone.
links.quote: The results showed a significant improvement in accuracy from 43 to 99% (p < 0.001), when guidelines were provided as context in a coherent corpus of text and non-text sources were converted into text.

links.effect: Few-shot learning did not seem to improve overall accuracy (no numbers given in the abstract)
links.quote: In addition, few-shot learning did not seem to improve overall accuracy.
